By the early seventeenth century, its cloth trade was strong enough to provoke complaints from rival towns, and its livestock fairs drew sellers and buyers from across Wales and the English border counties. It also became a stage for Welsh statecraft: in 1404 Owain Glyndwr held a parliament here during his revolt against Henry IV. Market rights, regional exchange and that assembly gave the town a place in Welsh history larger than its size alone would suggest.
simp_chinese: 马汉莱斯在威尔士戴菲地区成长为一座集镇。爱德华一世于1291年颁发特许状，准许欧文·德拉波尔每逢星期三开市，并每年举行两次集市，为当地商业奠定了持久的法律基础。到17世纪初，其布匹贸易已兴旺到招致其他城镇抱怨，牲畜集市也吸引了威尔士各地与英格兰边境诸郡的买卖双方。这里还是威尔士政治活动的舞台：1404年，欧文·格林多在反抗亨利四世期间于此召开议会。市场权利、区域交易和那次集会，使这座小城在威尔士历史上拥有超越其规模的地位。

english: Macina belongs to the Niger country of Mali. Its wider region was connected to Timbuktu, whose rise as a permanent settlement in the twelfth century was followed by prosperity through the trade in salt, gold and ivory.
simp_chinese: 马西纳属于马里的尼日尔河地区。广义地区与廷巴克图相连，该城十二世纪成为永久聚落，后来因盐、黄金与象牙贸易而繁荣。

english: Mackay Lake belongs to the ancient rock country of Canada’s Slave Craton. This exposed part of the northwestern Canadian Shield contains Archean greenstones and granitoids. Its broader geological province includes the Acasta Gneiss, among the oldest dated rocks on Earth.
simp_chinese: 麦凯湖属于加拿大斯雷夫克拉通的古老岩石地域。这片加拿大地盾西北部裸露区域包含太古宙绿岩与花岗质岩石。更广地质区中有阿卡斯塔片麻岩，是地球最古老的已定年岩石之一。

english: Known to the Pintupi people as Wilkinkarra, Lake Mackay lies on the edge of the Great Sandy Desert. It is an immense ephemeral salt lake rather than a permanent expanse of deep water, stretching roughly a hundred kilometres in both directions. Evaporation draws salts and minerals to the surface, leaving the brilliant white crust that contrasts with brown island hills, desert plants and occasional pools in the lowest ground. Sand ridges run east to west to its south. The English name belongs to a later age of exploration: Christopher Walker and Andy Everett reached its eastern side in 1913, and the name Lake Mackay was formally approved in 1934.
simp_chinese: 麦凯湖在平图皮人语言中称为威尔金卡拉，坐落于大沙沙漠边缘。它是一片辽阔的间歇性盐湖，并非终年深水的湖泊，东西与南北方向均延伸约一百公里。蒸发作用将盐分和矿物质带到地表，留下明亮的白色盐壳，与褐色岛丘、荒漠植物和低洼处偶尔汇聚的水池相映。湖泊南侧的沙脊呈东西走向。其英文名称属于较晚的探察时代：克里斯托弗·沃克与安迪·埃弗里特于1913年抵达湖泊东侧，麦凯湖之名则在1934年获得正式批准。

english: The Mackenzie flows north-northwest from Great Slave Lake through forest and tundra to the Arctic Ocean. At its mouth it forms a large delta, while its tributaries make it Canada's longest river system.
simp_chinese: 马更些河从大奴湖向西北偏北流经森林与苔原，注入北冰洋。河口形成广阔三角洲，其支流共同组成加拿大最长的河流水系。

english: The mountains now called the Mackenzie range run between the Liard and Peel rivers, forming part of the boundary between the Yukon and the Northwest Territories. Keele Peak, rising to 2,952 metres on the Yukon side, is the range's highest summit; Mount Nirvana farther east is the highest mountain of the Northwest Territories. The present name honours Alexander Mackenzie, Canada's second prime minister, and thus belongs to the nineteenth century. Fossils of Silurian fishes have been described from these mountains, preserving evidence of seas vastly older than the rugged landscape above them. Their ridges form a substantial interior mountain barrier in northwestern North America.
simp_chinese: 今天称作麦肯齐山脉的群山延伸于利亚德河与皮尔河之间，构成育空与西北地区的部分边界。育空一侧海拔2952米的基尔峰为全山脉最高点；更东面的尼尔瓦纳山则是西北地区的最高山峰。现名纪念加拿大第二任总理亚历山大·麦肯齐，因此属于十九世纪的命名。研究者曾依据山中发现的标本描述志留纪鱼类，化石保存着远比眼前崎岖山地更古老的海洋证据。重重山脊构成北美西北内陆的一道高大山地屏障。

english: The Mackenzie Uplands belong to the mountain belt between the Liard and Peel rivers. The wider range forms part of the Yukon–Northwest Territories boundary and rises highest at Keele Peak.
simp_chinese: 麦肯齐高地属于利亚德河与皮尔河之间的山地带。更广山脉构成育空与西北地区的部分边界，最高处为基尔峰。

english: Mackinac Island lies at the eastern entrance to the straits joining Lakes Michigan and Huron. Long home to an Odawa settlement, it became a strategic centre of the Great Lakes fur trade and later the site of a British fort.
simp_chinese: 麦基诺岛位于连接密歇根湖与休伦湖的海峡东口。这里长期有奥达瓦人聚居，后来成为五大湖毛皮贸易的重要据点，并建有英国堡垒。

english: Macomer stands on the southern ascent to Sardinia's Campeda plateau, in country well suited to grazing and the breeding of horses and cattle. Ptolemy knew the ancient settlement as Macopsissa, while Roman milestones at the parish church recall the road between Carales and Turris Libisonis. The surrounding district is also rich in the stone towers called nuraghi. In 1478 Macomer became the scene of a decisive battle between Sardinian and Aragonese forces. Under the Kingdom of Sardinia it later served, from 1767, as the capital of the Marquisate of Marghine, joining a group of neighbouring villages under a single title.
simp_chinese: 马科梅尔位于撒丁岛坎佩达高原的南坡，这片地域适宜放牧及饲养马匹、牛群。托勒密以马科普西萨之名称呼这处古老聚落，教区教堂前的罗马里程碑，则使人想起卡拉莱斯至图里斯利比索尼斯之间的古道。周围地域也密布被称为努拉吉的石塔。1478年，马科梅尔成为撒丁人与阿拉贡军队之间一场决定性战役的战场。到了撒丁王国时期，这里又自1767年起担任马尔吉内侯爵领的首府，将附近多个村落联系在同一封号之下。

english: Mâcon stands on the western bank of the Saône, between the country of Bresse and the hills leading towards Beaujolais. Its origins lie in an Aeduan fortified settlement and river port, probably founded early in the first century before Christ. Roman Matisco prospered, and a great hoard discovered in 1764 preserves a glimpse of that earlier wealth. In the Middle Ages the town was the centre of a Burgundian county and guarded the bridge towards the Savoyard lands of Bresse. It also controlled access through the valleys towards the plains of the Loire, making its position valuable in both commerce and war. Charles IX visited with his court in 1564, when Jeanne of Navarre and a large Huguenot gathering welcomed him. The town later gave its name to the surrounding wine country and became the administrative capital of Saône-et-Loire in 1790.
simp_chinese: 马孔坐落在索恩河西岸，介于布雷斯地区与通往博若莱的丘陵之间。它起源于埃杜伊人的设防聚落和河港，可能建于公元前1世纪初。罗马时代的马蒂斯科十分繁荣，1764年发现的一批大规模窖藏，留下了昔日财富的片影。中世纪，马孔是勃艮第一处伯国的中心，扼守通往萨伏依所属布雷斯地区的桥梁，也控制着沿河谷进入卢瓦尔平原的道路，因此在贸易与战争中都具有价值。1564年，查理九世携宫廷来访，纳瓦拉的让娜与大批胡格诺教徒迎接了他。城镇后来为周边葡萄酒产区提供名称，并于1790年成为索恩—卢瓦尔省的行政首府。

english: Macoriges belongs to the Havana region of Cuba. Its later maritime history was dominated by Havana’s sheltered harbor: the Spanish city became an important stop for homeward-bound galleons, protected by walls and coastal fortifications.
simp_chinese: 马科里赫斯属于古巴哈瓦那地区。后来的海上历史深受哈瓦那避风港影响：这座西班牙城市成为返航大帆船的重要停靠站，并以城墙和海岸堡垒保护港口。

english: Macoupin belongs to the Illinois country near the great Mississippian centre of Cahokia. At its height around 1100, that wider region’s principal city contained about 120 earthen monuments and was the largest urban centre of the Mississippian cultural world.
simp_chinese: 马库平县属于伊利诺伊地区，邻近密西西比文化重镇卡霍基亚。约1100年鼎盛时，广义地区的中心城市有约120座土筑建筑，是密西西比文化世界最大的城市。

english: Macquarie is a subantarctic island roughly halfway between Tasmania and Antarctica. It exposes part of the Macquarie Ridge where the Australian and Pacific plates meet. Royal penguins nest here, while sealers first recorded the uninhabited island in 1810 and named it after Governor Lachlan Macquarie.
simp_chinese: 麦夸里是一座大致位于塔斯马尼亚与南极洲之间的亚南极岛屿。它是澳大利亚板块与太平洋板块交界处麦夸里海岭露出的部分。皇家企鹅在此筑巢，捕海豹者于1810年首次记载这座无人岛，并以总督拉克伦·麦夸里命名。

english: Macquarie Heads faces the seas around Tasmania, south of the Australian mainland. Rising sea levels created Bass Strait and isolated the island’s Aboriginal inhabitants from mainland communities thousands of years ago.
simp_chinese: 麦夸里水道口面向澳大利亚大陆以南的塔斯马尼亚海域。数千年前，海平面上升形成巴斯海峡，使岛上原住民与大陆社群分隔开来。

english: The Macuxi homeland spans southern Guyana, northern Brazil and eastern Venezuela. Their language belongs to the Carib family, and villages are traditionally linked by paths with houses grouped around a central courtyard.
simp_chinese: 马库西人的故土跨越圭亚那南部、巴西北部与委内瑞拉东部。他们的语言属于加勒比语系，传统村落以道路相连，房屋围绕中央庭院排列。

english: Macuze belongs to the Mozambique coast of southeastern Africa. In the wider coastal region, Swahili port towns developed between the seventh and eleventh centuries and later attracted merchants from Arabia, Persia and India.
simp_chinese: 马库泽属于非洲东南部的莫桑比克海岸。更广阔的沿海地区在七至十一世纪间发展出斯瓦希里港镇，后来吸引了阿拉伯、波斯与印度商人。

english: Madaba's antiquity reaches back to the Middle Bronze Age. Once a frontier town of Moab, it appears in accounts of the struggles between Moab and Israel preserved on the Mesha Stele. Under Rome and Byzantium it belonged to Arabia Petraea, and a bishop of the city is recorded in the proceedings of the Council of Chalcedon in 451. Its most remarkable surviving work is the sixth-century mosaic map of the Holy Land, with a detailed view of Jerusalem. The modern town was resettled by Christian families from Karak in 1880, and their rebuilding brought the ancient mosaics to light.
simp_chinese: 马代巴的历史可追溯至中青铜时代。它曾是摩押的边境城镇，米沙石碑保存的摩押与以色列争斗记载中，也出现了此地。罗马和拜占庭时期，马代巴隶属阿拉伯佩特拉行省；451年迦克墩公会议的记录提到了该城主教。当地最引人注目的遗存，是6世纪以镶嵌画绘成的圣地地图，其中细致描绘了耶路撒冷。现代城镇由来自卡拉克的基督徒家庭于1880年重新定居，他们的重建工程使古代镶嵌画重见天日。

english: Madakalapu, better known as Batticaloa, stands on Sri Lanka’s east coast. Its old town occupies Puliyanthivu island within a lagoon, while the Tamil name Matakkalappu has been interpreted as referring to a muddy swamp or flat lagoon.
simp_chinese: 马达卡拉普更广为人知的名称是拜蒂克洛，位于斯里兰卡东海岸。其旧城占据潟湖中的普利扬蒂武岛；泰米尔语名称马塔卡拉普被解释为泥沼或平坦的潟湖。

english: Madanda belongs to the Pungwe country of southeastern Africa. The wider river rises below Mount Nyangani, descends through Mozambique and joins the Urema wetlands before reaching a broad estuary at Beira on the Mozambique Channel.
simp_chinese: 马丹达属于非洲东南蓬圭地区。更广阔的河流发源于尼扬加尼山下，经莫桑比克流向乌雷马湿地，最终在莫桑比克海峡畔贝拉形成宽阔河口。

english: Madaran belongs to the Bengal country of eastern South Asia. The wider region saw the Pala Empire rise in the eighth century, followed by Sena and Deva rulers and an independent Bengal Sultanate in the fourteenth.
simp_chinese: 马达兰属于南亚东部的孟加拉地区。更广阔的区域在八世纪兴起波罗王朝，随后经历塞纳、提婆统治，并在十四世纪形成独立的孟加拉苏丹国。

english: Madas belongs to the Djerid, the semi-desert oasis country of southwestern Tunisia. Bare pink hills rise among palm-growing oases and salt pans such as Chott el Djerid; Gafsa and Tozeur are principal centres within a landscape extending toward neighbouring Algeria.
simp_chinese: 马达斯属于突尼斯西南部半沙漠绿洲地区杰里德。裸露的粉红色丘陵分布在棕榈绿洲与杰里德盐湖等盐沼之间；加夫萨与托泽尔是主要中心，这片地景延伸至邻近阿尔及利亚方向。

english: Madaun belongs to the upper Kolyma country of the Russian Far East. The wider region embraces the Kolyma basin and the mountains dividing it from the Sea of Okhotsk, with severe subarctic winters and extensive permafrost.
simp_chinese: 马达翁属于俄罗斯远东科雷马河上游地区。整个地域涵盖科雷马流域及其与鄂霍次克海之间的分水岭山脉，冬季严寒，永冻土广布。

english: Madawaska belongs to the northern New Brunswick country. The wider region forms part of the homelands of Mi’kmaq, Wolastoqiyik and Passamaquoddy peoples, with Appalachian uplands occupying much of its north.
simp_chinese: 马达瓦斯卡属于新不伦瑞克北部地区。更广阔的区域是米克马克、沃拉斯托基与帕萨马科迪人的故土，北方大片土地由阿巴拉契亚高地占据。

english: The upper Cagayan country around Maddela lies between the Sierra Madre Mountains and the hinterland of the Mamparang ranges. Before the modern town developed, Ilongot or Bugkalot communities occupied the western uplands and stretches upstream toward Dupax, while Dumagat groups lived east of the river. The former maintained organized villages; the latter relied more heavily on hunting and root crops in the forest country. The settlement later called Maddela belongs chiefly to a twentieth-century history of migration. In 1919 a party of twenty Ilocanos led by the forester Vicente Velasco settled along the Cagayan and expanded into the Pinappagan valley. They planted rice, tobacco, maize and peanuts. Pinappagan became a regular town in 1950 and received the name Maddela in honour of a former governor, leaving the earlier Indigenous landscape beneath a much newer municipal identity.
simp_chinese: 马德拉周边的卡加延河上游地区，处于马德雷山脉与曼帕朗群山腹地之间。现代城镇形成以前，伊隆戈特人或布格卡洛特人居住在西部高地，以及向上游杜帕克斯延伸的地带；杜马加特群体则生活在河流以东。前者拥有组织化的村落，后者更多依靠林地狩猎与块根作物维持生计。后来称为马德拉的聚落，主要属于20世纪人口迁移的历史。1919年，护林员维森特·贝拉斯科率二十名伊洛卡诺人沿卡加延河定居，逐渐进入皮纳帕甘谷地，种植稻米、烟草、玉米与花生。皮纳帕甘于1950年成为正式城镇，并为纪念一位前省长而改名马德拉。较新的市镇身份之下，仍是更早的原住民土地。

english: This forest belongs to the vast Amazonian belt of moist tropical woodland, whose history includes many generations of human cultivation and settlement. Across Amazonia, indigenous communities developed fertile dark earth, known as terra preta, through sustained management of the soil; forest gardening also altered the woodland over centuries. Such evidence gives the region a deeper human history than its dense canopy alone suggests. Francisco de Orellana descended the Amazon in 1542 and described flourishing settlements along the river. The forest itself supports an extraordinary variety of life, from jaguars and black caimans to the countless insects and plants of the canopy and undergrowth.
simp_chinese: 这里的森林属于亚马逊广阔的湿润热带林带，其历史包含世代延续的人类耕作与聚居。亚马逊地区的原住民通过长期管理土壤，培育出称为terra preta的肥沃黑土；森林园艺也在数百年间改变了林地面貌。这些证据揭示出一段从浓密树冠下难以直接看出的深厚人类历史。1542年，弗朗西斯科·德·奥雷利亚纳顺亚马逊河而下，描述了沿河繁荣的聚落。森林本身则孕育着极其多样的生命，从美洲豹、黑凯门鳄，到树冠与林下无数的昆虫和植物。
